reviews.q: They have cut our lawn every week since spring and it has never looked better. The edges are always clean and the driveway is blown off every time.
Our backyard was completely overgrown. They cleared it out in one day, hauled everything away and now keep it mowed every other week.
Reliable, friendly and fair on price. I never have to call to remind anyone. They just show up and the yard looks great.

faqs.a: Palm Bay and nearby Brevard County towns like Melbourne, West Melbourne, Malabar and Sebastian. We go anywhere, so just call and ask.

faqs.q: How much does lawn mowing cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of your yard and how often you want service. After a quick look, you get a clear price per visit.

faqs.q: Do I need to sign a long contract?
faqs.a: Call and ask about the options. Most customers choose weekly or every other week service that fits their budget.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home when you come?
faqs.a: No. As long as we can get to the yard and gates are unlocked, we take care of everything and leave it clean.

faqs.q: Can you clean up a really overgrown yard?
faqs.a: Yes. We cut back tall grass and weeds, trim hedges and haul away the debris, then keep it sharp from there.
